// diagnostic

E1102

A value crossing a task, channel, parallel-worker, or safe-kernel boundary is not sendable.

What

A value crossing a task, channel, parallel-worker, or safe-kernel boundary is not sendable.

Why

Concurrent boundaries move owned data between workers. A view, trait value, mutable capture, borrowed closure, or thread-confined cell cannot cross.

Fix

Send plain owned data, make an ordinary owned copy when permitted, or use `Shared<T>` for deliberate shared state.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1102: tests/ui/E1130_kernel_proof.stderr.

Error [E0101]: this program has no `run` function
 Why: running a program starts at `fn run`, and the entry file doesn't define one
 Fix: add `fn run() { ... }` to the entry file

Error [E1102]: `#Kernel(.parallel)` cannot cross its worker boundary: sema cannot prove no reachable effects or opaque calls
  --> tests/ui/E1130_kernel_proof.jet:1:1
    |
  1 | #Kernel(.parallel) fn noisy(value: Int) Int -> {
    | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: a safe kernel crosses a worker boundary only after sema proves sendability, bounds, aliasing, captures, races, barriers, and control flow before TIR
 Fix: use a read-only effect-free expression over checked Core compute operations, or move provider/raw code behind its typed `#Unsafe` boundary
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1102
